title: November Court Pass: art catalog
about: The 12 November 2026 Court Pass items, laid out like December's (docs/court-pass.md, December's 12 items). Theme: a harvest court, Thanksgiving and late autumn, with no religious imagery. 6 free-lane rewards at tiers 5, 10, 15 (rare), 20, 25 and 30 (the finale), and 6 display-only premium items. The 8 decor items are SVGs in svg/<id>.svg, drawn in viewBox "0 0 100 H" with H = 100 / aspect and run through the kit's tools/room-art/import.mjs by ../build.mjs. The 4 shop items (2 avatars, 2 name styles) have no SVG: their look is the payload below, which must equal the cycles SQL and mobile/src/lib/nameStyles.ts. Each item also has a one-line `description` in the Shop's voice for SERVER's shop_items / home_items rows (December's catalog has none; build.mjs ignores the field).

style.base: art/my-place/catalog.json style: flat, front-on, rounded shapes, no outlines on most shapes, shading by tints, no gradients in item art, light from the top left.
harvest_rules: Leaves come in four colours only: leaf red, harvest gold, pumpkin and rust; the left half of a leaf is its colour lightened 12% (the lit face) and its veins are its colour darkened 25%.
Maple leaves are the seven-point star from draw.mjs; small ones (radius under 3) drop their veins. Oak leaves are an almond with a midrib.
Pumpkins have three lobes: the left lobe lit, the centre in the base colour, the right and back darker, with a brown stem and an optional green vine curl.
Every item has one pickleball or paddle in it, so the set reads as Pickleague's, not a generic autumn pack. No religious imagery, no pilgrims' buckles or crosses.

items.title: Gobble Gobble
items.description: Strutting onto the courts just in time for the feast.
items.brief: An avatar: the turkey emoji on a round warm-squash background #fbe3c4. No SVG; the app draws the emoji in the player's avatar circle as HomeGreeting does. The background is light enough that the turkey's brown and red feathers still read.

items.title: Pickleball Cornucopia
items.description: A horn of plenty, spilling over with pickleballs.
items.brief: A woven wicker horn (#c8955a, darker woven bands, a lighter dashed weave and a lit top edge) curling up to a tail on the left, its dark opening facing right. Out of it spill two wheat stalks, a red maple leaf, a gold oak leaf, a red apple, a big pickleball, a pumpkin, a small pickleball and an acorn. It stands on a dark-wood shelf base that touches the bottom edge and both sides, with a gold leaf lying on the base at the left.

items.title: Harvest Pumpkin Stack
items.description: Three pumpkins, one hay bale and a paddle that's seen a season.
items.brief: Three pumpkins stacked on a hay bale: a big pumpkin-orange one, a cream heirloom one in the middle and a harvest-gold one on top with a green vine curl. The straw bale (#e6c36a, lighter top, darker foot, short straw strokes, two bark-brown twine bands) spans the full width and touches the bottom edge. A court-green paddle leans on the right of the stack, a pickleball rests on the bale's left corner, and three fallen leaves lie on the straw.

items.title: Autumn Court Window
items.description: Golden-hour games under the turning trees.
items.brief: window_classic's frame, muntins and sill, looking out on a golden afternoon (#f4b860) with a pale low sun, a terracotta hill and round red, gold, orange and rust trees. Below, golden grass and a court-green court with white lines, a dark net, a pickleball and three fallen leaves on it; small leaves fall across the sky. A ring of autumn leaves with a rust bow hangs where the muntins cross, and the sill carries a row of fallen leaves with a small pumpkin at each end.

items.title: Harvest
items.description: Your name in the colours of a late-autumn court.
items.brief: A list name style: a horizontal gradient from rust #b5451b to harvest gold #e8a33d. No SVG; FlairName draws it (today as the first stop, solid, until the app has a gradient text renderer). The rust first stop keeps the name readable on light lists, the way December's deep ice does.

items.title: Golden Harvest
items.description: The finale: your name in burnt orange, twinkling like a harvest-moon night.
items.brief: The finale: a profile name style with the name in burnt orange #c2571a and three gold sparkles twinkling around it, looping. It reuses the existing sparkle effect (SparkleName in NameStyleAnimations.tsx, as hero-anim-sparkle does with a different base), so the app needs only the nameStyles.ts entry, no new animation. In lists it degrades to the solid base colour, like every animated style.

items.title: Gratitude Court Poster
items.brief: art_tournament_poster's layout on cream paper: a rust panel with a big harvest-gold maple leaf, a pickleball at its heart, two small leaves drifting and rolling pumpkin and wheat hills at the bottom. Under it a court-green band reads GRATITUDE in white with COURT in wheat below, between two white rules. Wheat tape strips at both top corners reach the top edge.

items.title: Pie Time
items.description: Save room for dessert after doubles.
items.brief: An avatar: the pie emoji on a warm pastry background #f6e1c3. No SVG; the app draws it like any shop avatar. Premium preview only: it is shown, never granted or sold.

items.title: Autumn Leaf Garland
items.description: Fallen leaves, strung up for the season.
items.brief: A twine line swagged twice across the top, held by three bark-brown pegs that touch y = 0. Fifteen charms hang from it on short strings at two drop heights: maple and oak leaves in leaf red, harvest gold, pumpkin and rust, three acorns and two pickleballs. Each charm tilts a little, and the lowest one stops well inside the 25-unit box.

items.title: Harvest Plaid Pillow
items.description: Flannel-soft and ready for the post-game nap.
items.brief: A soft pumpkin pillow (rx about 40% of its height) in a harvest plaid: wide rust bands both ways at 45% opacity, thin cream lines and thin bark lines, every stripe cut to the pillow's rounded outline. In the middle a cream oval patch with a dashed rust stitch holds a harvest-gold maple leaf with a pickleball on it. A lighter highlight sits top left and a dashed seam runs just inside the edge.

items.title: Woven Harvest Rug
items.description: A hand-woven court for the coziest games of the year.
items.brief: rug_court_lines' trapezoid court, woven: a rust border with a dashed wheat stitch, a wheat-gold court, a slightly darker kitchen and cream court lines. A big pumpkin maple leaf with a pickleball, squashed to lie flat on the floor, replaces the net at the centre, and a small flat leaf sits in each service box. Wheat dots finish the four corners.

items.title: Harvest Hall Paddle Wall
items.description: The barn where the season's best paddles hang.
items.brief: rack_champion's paddle fan on a red barn: a barn-red wall under a bark-brown roof with a cream eave, a cream-trimmed gable whose peak touches y = 0 and a gold round loft window, and a darker recessed panel with board lines, a faint cream X-brace and a row of small leaves under the eave. Four paddles fan out (two pumpkin, two wheat) behind a gold centre paddle with a rust maple leaf, with a small pumpkin in each bottom corner. A gold plate sits at the bottom, as on the champion rack.
